title: The Effects of DHA on Periodontitis

sections.abstract:
The purpose of this study is to determine whether docosahexaenoic acid (DHA) is effective in the treatment of periodontitis in adults.

Posted outcomes: Change in Pocket Depth (mm). timeframe=Baseline and 3 months. Aspirin & Docosahexaenoic Acid=-0.71 (±0.07); Aspirin & Placebo=-0.54 (±0.07). p=<0.05
